thread:
maya: quick sync — noticed probe penalty double-apply between edge-proxy and quota-broker. saw requests get 429 then still charged a provisional penalty.
jon: @maya can you paste a request/response log?
maya: here — snippet:
```
INGRESS -> /v1/generate probe_id=abc123
RESP 429 {"error":"rate_limited","penalty":0.4}
PROXY -> quota-broker /v1/penalty/apply
BODY {"probe_id":"abc123","score":0.4}
RESP 200 {"ok":true}
LATER: quota-broker records probe twice
```
kevin: hmm. quota-broker expects score in [0,100] not 0..1. so 0.4 interpreted as 40 -> huge penalty :facepalm: 
lia: oh no. that's the classic unit mismatch. we should standardize exchange proto.
maya: agreed. proposal: canonical "penalty_exchange_v1" header with fields: score(float 0..1), weight, source, expires_unix.
jon: prototype mapping in pseudocode:
```
if incoming.score <= 1.0:
  normalized = incoming.score * 100
else:
  normalized = incoming.score
```
kevin: that helps but also need idempotency: probe_id should be deduped — dedupe window = 60s.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423 — edge->quota penalty double-charge. assigned to @kevin
lia: also think about HTTP semantics: edge should send 202 Accepted for asynchronous apply, quota-broker should return 409 if duplicate
maya: and telemetry: add tags: source=edge-proxy, route, model, probe_id. add metric penalty_applied{dedupe=true/false}
jon: can we avoid numeric mapping by using explicit unit field? e.g., "score_unit": "fraction" | "bps" | "points"
kevin: yes, add unit. fallback order: unit -> range inference -> normalize. add validation with schema-check on receive
lia: ops note: we'll need a migration plan: rollback-safe. Suggest: start by accepting both unit types but log mismatches, then flip quota-broker strict mode after 2 weeks
maya: action items:
- kevin: implement schema validation + dedupe (ETA 2d)
- jon: update edge-proxy to emit penalty_exchange_v1 header (ETA 3d)
- lia: update ops runbook + incident response (ETA 1d)
- maya: write short RFC for the header and mapping rules (ETA EOD)
kevin: ack. will open PR referencing INC-2026-0423
jon: going to add unit tests for mapping and an integration test with local quota-broker stub
lia: :thumbsup: thanks all — ping me if you need canary hostnames
maya: thanks — will follow up in the RFC thread
sre-bot: reminder scheduled: follow-up sync in #eng-security tomorrow 10:00
